core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hosna corresponds to the Arabic form حسنى (Arabic root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); حُسْنَى (Ḥusnā)). Its core sense is beauty, goodness, excellence. Hosna is Arabic حُسْنَى (Ḥusnā) 'most beautiful, best', the feminine elative of حَسَن (ḥasan), from the root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n). The source gave حُسْن and glossed the name 'Pure, Hallowed, Precious', which is unsupported; the lexical sense is 'most beautiful, best'. Same name as husna.
